transformations.name: Transformations: What Stays the Same When Everything Changes
transformations.truth: Identity preserved under transformation. Vectors enable movement. What stays the same when everything changes?
transformations.qfep_connection: Transformations modify system states while preserving essential structure. Vectors are the language of change—direction and magnitude enable translation, rotation, scale.
transformations.formula: T(v) = M × v, v = (x,y,z), dot(a,b) = |a||b|cos(θ), cross(a,b) ⊥ a,b
transformations.demonstration: Translate: vectors as displacement. Rotate: dot product measures angle, cross product finds axis. Scale: vectors as multipliers.
transformations.description: Vectors and transformations together. Vectors give direction and magnitude; transformations apply them. Translation uses vector addition, rotation uses dot and cross products. This is the grammar of spatial change.
learning_objectives: Vector subtraction: direction between two points
Translation: moving objects via vector displacement
Rotation: changing orientation using angles from dot product
Cross product: finding perpendicular axis for rotation
Scale: changing size uniformly or non-uniformly
Projection and reflection: mirrors and collision response
